warnings: The supplied manifest schema in this call does not define required/minimum/maximum fields, so those source constraints were retained in item.constraints rather than emitted as additional properties.

The document explicitly defines Q130 as 14 attributes with therapy and NONE columns. The dictionary supplies all corresponding variables, but the document table has no response-item candidate rows for these children; Q130_3_1 through Q130_3_99 were explicitly preserved and the remaining Q130 children are represented in block source_variables and must be expanded into separate response items during analyst review.

The questionnaire states that Q120 and Q125 randomize in the same order as Q110, but the dictionary labels omit q120_4/q120_5 and q125_4/q125_5 from the visible document rows; the dictionary variables were retained and mapped.

The dataset dictionary contains qtestvideo and qpassword as candidate-question variables, but the supplied questionnaire text contains no corresponding respondent question; they are excluded as dictionary-only/application fields pending programming confirmation.
The provided document includes Section 8 and the Appendix privacy notice. The privacy notice contains no response variables and therefore does not create questionnaire groups.
Administrative defaults are application-handled and were not duplicated as questionnaire groups or blocks.
